7225.title: Default picker opens mutate document-wide overlay state
7225.rootCauseOneLine: The model picker defaults to modal Radix Popover, which locks body scrolling, changes inherited pointer events, and hides the composer from assistive technology on open; Escape restores the body state.

prReviews.verdict: Closed and unmerged; static alignment only, not executed

7225.proposedFix: Make the six affected picker defaults explicitly nonmodal, exercise production defaults in regression tests, and verify dismissal, focus, and compact drawers. No autopilot fix: six implementation files already exceed the five-file limit.
7225.caveats: Two clean trusted checkouts reproduce DOM mutations, not Chromium style-recalculation duration or the reporter's plugin-loaded page. Full regression patch and exact output are inline; raw evidence stays outside this public repository.
